high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the Financial Express website, specifically under the "Lifestyle" section. The title of the article is "Why Bruce Lee didn’t lift heavy." The article discusses fitness writer Kate Neudecker's explanation that Bruce Lee focused more on speed, flexibility, and endurance rather than lifting heavy weights. According to Neudecker, Bruce Lee weighed 64 kg and stood 172 cm tall. She notes that lifting 43 kg for squats was sufficient for his needs. The article delves into Bruce Lee's workout routine, which aligns with his training philosophy: staying lean,
